speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, please describe your symptoms in detail. You mentioned fatigue, flank pain, and fever following recent antibiotic treatment for acute sinusitis; have you noticed any changes in your urination, such as frequency, urgency, or blood?

speaker: Doctor
text:
